_name: Inked + named — hasInk=true (placeholder gone, strokes drawn), name filled, undo/clear enabled, submit enabled (green gradient, 'Looks good — sign the contract →')
_note: hasInk + name drive the submit's enabled styling. The canvas strokes (strokesRef) are imperative refs, not signals — isolate can only fake the post-stroke UI via hasInk; real ink must be drawn by the Events pointer sequence.
